name: Intra-regional trade share
notes: Official UN Comtrade public preview API, HS cmdCode=TOTAL, flows M and X queried separately with partner2Code=0, customsCode=C00, motCode=0 to keep each response under the 500-record preview cap, bilateral partners. value = 100 * two-way trade with same UN M49 sub-region partners / total two-way trade; retrieved 2026-08-16; 807 rows, 34 markets, 2000-2024. M49 sub-regions are fixed geography, so membership does not change over time and the series needs no re-basing; a trade-bloc taxonomy would have introduced structural breaks. Partner sub-regions come from the full ISO 3166 / UN M49 table archived at Raw Data/Topic 3-5/UN M49/Original/iso3166_m49_subregions.csv, not from the project's own 34 markets. Resolving through the 34 markets alone produced a structural 0% for the nine markets that are the sole project member of their sub-region (Italy, Mexico, Australia, Egypt, Nigeria, South Africa, Kazakhstan, DR Congo, United Kingdom), which was false. About 1.6% of partner records carry Comtrade special codes ('Areas, nes', dissolved states); they remain in the denominator as real trade but cannot be attributed to a region, so the share is very slightly conservative. Comtrade also normalises some reporter codes in its responses (Italy is queried as 381 and returned as 380), which is handled by an alias table.
